deploy.description: New claim in the Notion Expense Claims data source -> resolve the claimant (Created by) to their Xero contact by email -> raise a DRAFT Xero bill EXP-<Claim ID> against that contact, account by Category, receipt attached -> write the bill link back to the claim's 'Xero bill' property.

trigger.authentication_note: work.flowers | Dennis — the same NotionCLIAPI connection as the notion_wf alias. The Expense Claims DB must be shared with the Zapier integration or the trigger and every API read 404.
trigger.trigger_note: Notion POLLING 'New Data Source Item', one run per new claim. New-item polling is unaffected by the durable dedupe bug (W6ZE93-VMEWP) because every claim is a new page id — but it also means a claim fires exactly once: a run that fails on a fixable claim is replayed by hand with trigger-workflow --input '{"page_id":"<id>"}'. No external URL to wire up.

notion.note: Write-back + guard property: 'Xero bill' (url), added 2026-10-07 with this Zap. Category options 'Training & courses', 'Events & sponsorship' and 'Memberships & publications' were added the same day. No page is created here, so repo rule 5 (default template) does not apply.

xero.tax: SGD claims: line amounts tax-inclusive at the account's default tax rate (line_tax_type omitted). Any other currency: NoTax.
xero.contact_match: Notion user email (GET /v1/users/{created_by}) == Xero Contact.EmailAddress, active contacts only. No match or several matches fails the run; no contact is ever created.
